<!--
  The most useful bug report for this project answers one extra question: does
  the interface say something that is not true? A wrong layout is a bug; an
  progress bar that moves while nothing is playing, a "playing" state with no
  audio, or a claim the code cannot back up is a worse kind of bug, and this
  repository treats it as one.
-->
